title: Show Ontario service-area text in footer brand/about copy

requirements.summary: Update footer brand/about service-area copy so it clearly includes the word “Ontario” while keeping the Contact Us section phone-only.
acceptanceCriteria: On all pages, the footer’s Foam Daddy brand/about text includes the word “Ontario”.
The footer “Contact Us” section still displays only the phone number “204 526 5420” and no email, address, or other contact methods.

file_operations.description: Adjust the Foam Daddy brand/about paragraph in the footer so the service-area copy clearly includes the word “Ontario” (e.g., explicitly mentioning Ontario in addition to Manitoba), ensuring it remains in the footer brand/about area and does not add or change any non-phone contact details in the Contact Us section (keep phone-only: 204 526 5420).
